app.name: Health Buddy
app.tagline: Meals, steps and sleep for the whole family, in English and Telugu.
error.network: Can't reach Health Buddy's server. Check that the API is running, then try again.
auth.name: Your name
auth.consentBody: Health Buddy stores the meals you log, your family's profiles (age, height, weight) and steps, sleep and heart rate from Health Connect. It is used only to show your dashboard and weekly suggestions. Meal text and photos you submit are sent to Google Gemini to identify foods. You can download or delete everything at any time from Settings. Health Buddy is not medical advice.
auth.consentCheck: I've read this and agree to Health Buddy storing this data.
auth.consentRequired: Agree to the health data notice to continue.

caution.child: Children are growing, so Health Buddy never sets a calorie limit or suggests weight loss for them. Talk to a paediatrician or dietitian about your child's needs.
caution.pregnancy: During pregnancy Health Buddy keeps the target at maintenance and never suggests eating less. Follow your doctor's advice on diet.
caution.see_doctor: Some numbers here are worth discussing with a doctor or dietitian.

settings.title: Settings
settings.exportHint: Everything Health Buddy stores about your account and family.
settings.deleteBody: This removes your account, family profiles, meals and health data. It can't be undone.
settings.aboutBody: Nutrition values come from the Indian Nutrient Databank (INDB), USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts. The AI only names the foods and portions; calories, protein and targets are worked out in code. Health Buddy is not medical advice.
